explication: Ransack adds search and sorting to Rails applications. The principal workflow is an application or user supplying search parameters, Ransack building a search tree, and its Active Record integration translating that search into a relation the application can use. Form helpers support constructing search interfaces; configuration, predicates, custom ransackers, and translation provide extension points. The excerpts show loading and selected search/context behavior, but not the complete runtime call chain, so unverified connections are dashed with null evidence.
